model_parameters.helpText: A list of tools the model may call.

model_parameters.label: Temperature
model_parameters.helpText: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Stream
model_parameters.helpText: The stream parameter in the API controls whether the response is sent in incremental updates, like tokenized data as it's generated, or as a complete result in one go.

model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Temperature

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Max input tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of input tokens to send to the model. If not specified, max_input_tokens is the model's context length limit minus a small buffer.

model_parameters.label: P
model_parameters.helpText: Ensures that only the most likely tokens, with total probability mass of p, are considered for generation at each step. If both k and p are enabled, p acts after k.

model_parameters.label: K
model_parameters.helpText: Ensures only the top k most likely tokens are considered for generation at each step.

model_parameters.label: Citation quality
model_parameters.helpText: Dictates the approach taken to generating citations as part of the RAG flow by allowing the user to specify whether they want 'accurate' results or 'fast' results.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Used to reduce repetitiveness of generated tokens. The higher the value, the stronger a penalty is applied to previously present tokens, proportional to how many times they have already appeared in the prompt or prior generation.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: If specified, the backend will make a best effort to sample tokens deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Stream
model_parameters.helpText: The stream parameter in the API controls whether the response is sent in incremental updates, like tokenized data as it's generated, or as a complete result in one go.

model_parameters.label: Temperature

metadata.notes: Input/output cost per token is dbu cost * $0.070, based on databricks Llama 3.1 70B conversion. Number provided for reference, '*_dbu_cost_per_token' used in actual calculation.

model_parameters.label: Temperature
model_parameters.helpText: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Voice
model_parameters.helpText: The voice to use for speech synthesis. You can use pre-made voices or custom cloned voices.

model_parameters.label: Stability
model_parameters.helpText: Controls the consistency and predictability of the voice. Lower values allow for more variable and expressive speech, while higher values make the voice more stable and consistent.

model_parameters.label: Similarity Boost
model_parameters.helpText: Enhances the similarity to the original voice. Higher values make the generated speech closer to the original voice characteristics.

model_parameters.label: Style Exaggeration
model_parameters.helpText: Controls how much the AI should exaggerate the style of the voice. Higher values result in more expressive and dramatic speech.

model_parameters.label: Speaker Boost
model_parameters.helpText: Boost the similarity to the speaker and reduces differences between speakers. Useful when using different voices in the same audio.

model_parameters.label: Model
model_parameters.helpText: The TTS model to use for generation.

model_parameters.label: Language
model_parameters.helpText: The language code for the text to be synthesized. Required for multilingual models to optimize pronunciation.

model_parameters.label: Output Format
model_parameters.helpText: The audio format for the generated speech.

model_parameters.label: Optimize Streaming Latency
model_parameters.helpText: Optimize the model for lower latency at the cost of quality. Higher values reduce latency but may decrease audio quality.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: Random seed for reproducible generation. If set, the same text with the same settings will produce identical audio.

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Stream
model_parameters.helpText: The stream parameter in the API controls whether the response is sent in incremental updates, like tokenized data as it's generated, or as a complete result in one go.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.helpText: The stream parameter in the API controls whether the response is sent in incremental updates, like tokenized data as it's generated, or as a complete result in one go.

model_parameters.label: Prompt Tools (Functions)
model_parameters.helpText: A list of tools the model may call.

model_parameters.label: Temperature
model_parameters.helpText: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Temperature
model_parameters.helpText: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Stream
model_parameters.helpText: The stream parameter in the API controls whether the response is sent in incremental updates, like tokenized data as it's generated, or as a complete result in one go.

model_parameters.label: Metadata
model_parameters.helpText: A unique identifier representing your end-user.

model_parameters.label: Temperature
model_parameters.helpText: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Temperature
model_parameters.helpText: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Stream
model_parameters.helpText: The stream parameter in the API controls whether the response is sent in incremental updates, like tokenized data as it's generated, or as a complete result in one go.

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Stream
model_parameters.helpText: The stream parameter in the API controls whether the response is sent in incremental updates, like tokenized data as it's generated, or as a complete result in one go.

model_parameters.label: Temperature
model_parameters.helpText: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Stream
model_parameters.helpText: The stream parameter in the API controls whether the response is sent in incremental updates, like tokenized data as it's generated, or as a complete result in one go.

model_parameters.label: Prompt Tools (Functions)
model_parameters.helpText: A list of tools the model may call.

model_parameters.label: Temperature
model_parameters.helpText: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Stream
model_parameters.helpText: The stream parameter in the API controls whether the response is sent in incremental updates, like tokenized data as it's generated, or as a complete result in one go.

model_parameters.label: Prompt Tools (Functions)
model_parameters.helpText: A list of tools the model may call.

model_parameters.label: Temperature
model_parameters.helpText: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Stream
model_parameters.helpText: The stream parameter in the API controls whether the response is sent in incremental updates, like tokenized data as it's generated, or as a complete result in one go.

model_parameters.label: Prompt Tools (Functions)
model_parameters.helpText: A list of tools the model may call.

model_parameters.label: Temperature
model_parameters.helpText: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Response Format
model_parameters.helpText: The format of the response. If set to 'json', the response will be a JSON object with the keys 'choices' and 'logprobs'. If set to 'text', the response will be a string with the completion text. If set to 'Structured output', the response will match the supplied JSON schema.

subFields.label: JSON Schema
subFields.helpText: A JSON schema that the model will follow when generating the response.

model_parameters.label: Stream
model_parameters.helpText: The stream parameter in the API controls whether the response is sent in incremental updates, like tokenized data as it's generated, or as a complete result in one go.

model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed

model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs

model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Temperature
model_parameters.helpText: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Stream
model_parameters.helpText: The stream parameter in the API controls whether the response is sent in incremental updates, like tokenized data as it's generated, or as a complete result in one go.

model_parameters.label: Temperature
model_parameters.helpText: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Stream
model_parameters.helpText: The stream parameter in the API controls whether the response is sent in incremental updates, like tokenized data as it's generated, or as a complete result in one go.

model_parameters.label: Temperature

model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Temperature
model_parameters.helpText: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Stream
model_parameters.helpText: The stream parameter in the API controls whether the response is sent in incremental updates, like tokenized data as it's generated, or as a complete result in one go.

model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Temperature
model_parameters.helpText: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Stream
model_parameters.helpText: The stream parameter in the API controls whether the response is sent in incremental updates, like tokenized data as it's generated, or as a complete result in one go.

model_parameters.label: Temperature

model_parameters.label: Max Output Tokens

model_parameters.label: Stop Sequences
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Stream

model_parameters.label: Logprobs

model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty

model_parameters.label: Prompt Tools (Functions)
model_parameters.helpText: A list of tools the model may call.

model_parameters.label: Temperature
model_parameters.helpText: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Stream
model_parameters.helpText: The stream parameter in the API controls whether the response is sent in incremental updates, like tokenized data as it's generated, or as a complete result in one go.

model_parameters.label: Reasoning Effort
model_parameters.helpText: Reasoning effort is used to give the model guidance on how many reasoning tokens it should generate before creating a response to the prompt. You can specify one of low, medium, or high for this parameter, where low will favor speed and economical token usage, and high will favor more complete reasoning at the cost of more tokens generated and slower responses. The default value is medium, which is a balance between speed and reasoning accuracy.

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.label: Top P
model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Stream
model_parameters.helpText: The stream parameter in the API controls whether the response is sent in incremental updates, like tokenized data as it's generated, or as a complete result in one go.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.
model_parameters.disabledText: Presence Penalty value is fixed at 0 and cannot be changed at the moment for this model.

model_parameters.label: Reasoning Effort
model_parameters.helpText: Reasoning effort is used to give the model guidance on how many reasoning tokens it should generate before creating a response to the prompt. You can specify one of low, medium, or high for this parameter, where low will favor speed and economical token usage, and high will favor more complete reasoning at the cost of more tokens generated and slower responses. The default value is medium, which is a balance between speed and reasoning accuracy.

model_parameters.label: Stop
model_parameters.helpText: Custom text sequences that will cause the model to stop generating.

model_parameters.helpText: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs

model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Frequency Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Number between 0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

model_parameters.label: Logit Bias
model_parameters.helpText: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion.

model_parameters.label: Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the content of message.

model_parameters.label: Top Logprobs
model_parameters.helpText: An integer between 0 and 5 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability.

model_parameters.label: Number of Responses
model_parameters.helpText: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model_parameters.label: Presence Penalty
model_parameters.helpText: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

model_parameters.label: Seed
model_parameters.helpText: (BETA) - System will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters should return the same result.

model_parameters.label: Stream
model_parameters.helpText: The stream parameter in the API controls whether the response is sent in incremental updates, like tokenized data as it's generated, or as a complete result in one go.

model_parameters.label: Metadata
model_parameters.helpText: A unique identifier representing your end-user.

model_parameters.label: Prompt Tools (Functions)
model_parameters.helpText: A list of tools the model may call.

model_parameters.label: Max Tokens
model_parameters.helpText: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the Result.
